title: TUTORIAL Miniature titmouse made of polymer clay 1:12 scale dollhouse | PDF + video
description: The price includes a tutorial on creating a miniature titmouse for dollhouses and miniature scenes at a scale of 1:12. This tutorial is a PDF file with a description of the necessary materials, step-by-step text instructions, and a link to the video. For your convenience, the video is uploaded to YouTube and has subtitles in English. An active link to the video is included inside the PDF file and can also be accessed via QR code.
